content.value_statement: NestJS teams often lose time on dependency injection, modules, testing, and authentication issues. This skill gives focused diagnostics, patterns, and validation steps for production NestJS work.
actual_capabilities: Diagnoses NestJS module, provider, and dependency injection errors.
Recommends module boundaries, shared modules, and circular dependency fixes.
Guides Jest, Supertest, unit, integration, and e2e testing setup.
Reviews TypeORM, Mongoose, and Prisma integration patterns.
Troubleshoots Passport, JWT, guards, interceptors, pipes, and middleware.
Provides validation steps such as build, lint, unit tests, and e2e tests.
limitations: It does not replace project-specific security review or penetration testing.
It relies on the files and context the assistant can access.
It may recommend commands, but users should review commands before running them.
It focuses on NestJS and may defer unrelated frontend or database tuning work.

use_cases.title: Fix Dependency Injection Failures
use_cases.description: Find missing providers, exports, imports, and circular dependencies in a NestJS service or module.

use_cases.title: Strengthen API Test Coverage
use_cases.description: Plan focused unit, integration, and e2e tests for controllers, services, guards, and repositories.

use_cases.title: Review Backend Architecture
use_cases.description: Assess module organization, authentication flow, database access, error handling, and performance risks.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Basic Error
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner troubleshooting for a visible NestJS error.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this NestJS error and explain the likely cause. Identify the module or provider to check first.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Module Design
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of module boundaries and provider exports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these NestJS modules and suggest a cleaner structure. Focus on imports, exports, providers, and circular dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Testing Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced testing plan for a feature with services and controllers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a NestJS testing plan for this feature. Separate unit, integration, and e2e coverage, and name the key mocks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this NestJS service for production readiness. Check authentication, configuration, database access, error handling, logging, and performance.

output_examples.input: A service fails with a dependency resolution error after moving it into a new module.
output: Identifies the missing provider or export path.
Explains which module should own the service.
Suggests validation with build and focused unit tests.

output_examples.input: An API uses JWT authentication but requests return unauthorized responses.
output: Checks strategy imports, secret configuration, token format, and guard placement.
Separates configuration issues from request header issues.
Recommends targeted tests for protected routes.

output_examples.input: A team wants to add reliable tests around a TypeORM repository service.
output: Defines which repository methods should be mocked.
Recommends focused service tests before broader integration tests.
Calls out database connection setup risks for e2e tests.

best_practices: Provide the error message, related module files, and recent changes together.
Ask for validation steps that match your project scripts and test setup.
Share authentication, database, and configuration context when those areas are involved.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to solve unrelated frontend or generic TypeScript problems without NestJS context.
Do not run suggested commands until you understand what each command checks.
Do not treat architecture advice as a substitute for reviewing production requirements.

faq.question: What NestJS problems does this skill handle best?
faq.answer: It is strongest for modules, providers, dependency injection, testing, authentication, databases, middleware, guards, interceptors, and configuration.

faq.question: Can it write tests for my application?
faq.answer: It can design and review Jest, Supertest, unit, integration, and e2e test strategies using your existing patterns.

faq.question: Does it support TypeORM and Mongoose?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for TypeORM entities, repositories, connections, Mongoose schemas, model injection, and related testing.

faq.question: Can it debug JWT and Passport issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks strategy setup, guard usage, token format, secrets, module imports, and configuration loading order.

faq.question: Will it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It describes diagnostic and validation commands that users or agents can review before execution.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
